attempts.text:
The postoperative pathology reveals a Gleason 4+3 with ISUP grade group 3, pathological stage pT3b. Adverse findings include positive surgical margins and invasion of the seminal vesicles, as documented by the surgical pathology report. A reassuring finding is the absence of lymph node metastasis, as stated in the surgical pathology report: "there was no lymph node metastasis." The nodal status is documented as "there was no lymph node metastasis." The preoperative PSA level was 12.

The prognosis is influenced by the positive margins and seminal vesicle invasion. The absence of lymph node metastasis is a mitigating factor. Missing postoperative PSA data prevents assessment of biochemical recurrence. Missing nodal sampling, while not explicitly noted as missing in this specific record, would widen uncertainty regarding nodal status if it were absent. Information regarding postoperative PSA and its trajectory is crucial for revising the prognosis.

attempts.text:
The postoperative pathology reveals a Gleason 4+3 with tertiary pattern 5 (ISUP grade group 3) and pathological stage pT3b. Adverse findings include positive surgical margins and invasion of the seminal vesicles. A reassuring finding is the absence of lymphovascular invasion and no lymph node metastasis, as stated in the surgical pathology report: "The robot-assisted radical prostatectomy specimen showed Gleason 4+3 with tertiary pattern 5 (ISUP grade group 3), pathological stage pT3b. Extraprostatic extension was present; surgical margins were positive; the seminal vesicles were invaded; lymphovascular invasion was absent; there was no lymph node metastasis."

The absence of documented postoperative PSA prevents assessment of biochemical recurrence. The status of nodal sampling is not explicitly detailed, which widens uncertainty regarding the extent of disease beyond the documented findings. Postoperative PSA and its trajectory are crucial information that would revise the prognosis. The current findings present a mixed picture, with local and regional adverse features noted, counterbalanced by the absence of nodal metastasis.
